title: Projection-normalized scalar transport of total inverse limit
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, an adic datum d on its valuation ring, a scheme T and a coefficient model C of [def-sf-open-quotient-koszul-models]. The pointwise derived scalar equivalence carries the total right-derived strict inverse limit to the derived scalar equivalence after the original total inverse limit. There is such a natural comparison whose equation on every complex is the localization of the ordinary scalar/limit comparison. The latter is the inverse comparison normalized by every ordinary tower projection, exactly the limit_model formula in OpenDvrLimitComparison. No quotient reduction, completeness predicate or open immersion is required.

source.place: Tag 0941; exact equivalences preserve the universal right-derived pair (Tag 05RR). Unique ordinary inverse-limit comparison by its projections.

proof.text:
Proof: scalar restriction is an exact equivalence. Its ordinary limit comparison is
preservesLimitNatIso, hence is fixed by all projections. Apply rightDerivedSquare to
the coefficient equivalence and its pointwise tower equivalence, with the universal
right-derived pairs. Its factorization equation is the required equation on complexes.
The localization comparison through the homotopy category is the recorded
reconstructionRlimComparison. Compose the factorization equation with the inverse
tower-localization isomorphism and the derived comparison to obtain limit_model.
